Name: Flowers Bubble Tea - French translation
Author: Damadelfalco
Description:
French localization file for the Flowers Bubble Tea Mod by Vin163, which you can find here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33531]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33531[/url]

Install the Flowers Bubble Tea mod as a prerequisite.Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33531]this MOD[/url] and unzip the zip file.
Take the fr.json file and copy it into the mod's folder name "i18n".
Path: Stardew Valley\Mods[CP] Flowers BubbleTea\i18n\ the fr.json file should be placed here.
